environment.description: ECS Fargate task in private subnet with com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). Endpoint policy document restricts PutObject to condition aws:ResourceAccount matching 112233445566 AND s3:prefix starting with 'builds/' AND s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption equals 'AES256'. Route table associated with task subnet has pl-63a5400a (S3 prefix list) routed exclusively through the VPC endpoint - no NAT path for S3 traffic. IAM role has s3:PutObject but the VPC endpoint policy acts as an additional authorization boundary evaluated before the IAM policy allows the request through.

config.network: Private subnet, S3 Gateway VPC Endpoint vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890, route table forces all S3 traffic through endpoint
config.iam_policy: s3:PutObject on Resource: arn:aws:s3:::* with no conditions
config.exposure: Internal ALB, accessible from developer VPN
